issues.explanation: Public __invoke lacks the PHPDoc that conventions require on touched public methods.
No test covers history with fewer than 3 called tickets leaving fairness untripped.
Exactly-once skip-and-pick-next branch for a concurrently called candidate has no test.
Stale TODO about linking the concurrent-call test remains after the test was added.

conventions.evidence: Uses app/Actions/* for domain write, Pest test, docs/business-rules.md + docs/architecture.md + CHANGELOG.md updated; public __invoke at app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:35 has no PHPDoc despite conventions requiring PHPDoc on touched public methods.

readability.evidence: app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:49/83-89 clear names candidateIds/fairnessTripped, small focused methods, comments explain queue/candidate locking; stale TODO at docs/architecture.md:182-183 is a nit.

requirements.evidence: Contract met: app/Enums/CallMode.php:7-9 values, app/Exceptions/NoWaitingTicketsException.php:4 extends RuntimeException, app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:35 signature; ordering :126-131 priority desc/issued_at/id, modes :120-124, fairness :90-109 called_at desc/id desc + normal exists, queue lock + stale re-read :40-47, candidate lock + re-check + skip :61-79, called marking + refresh :71-76.

scope.evidence: Diff touches only CallNextTicket.php, CallMode.php, NoWaitingTicketsException.php, tests/Feature/CallNextTicketTest.php, docs/business-rules.md, docs/architecture.md, CHANGELOG.md; every hunk serves the task.

security.evidence: Task states caller is trusted so no policy/gate needed; direct attribute assignment avoids mass-assignment, no Blade/Livewire input, no secrets or unsafe output checked.

simplicity.evidence: Lean 117-line action reusing TicketStatus/InactiveQueueException, two focused helpers fairnessTripped/candidateIds, no service layers or duplication.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/CallNextTicketTest.php:246-487 covers ordering, id tie-break, queue isolation, priority_only/normal_only, fairness trip/no-normal/reset/ignore-modes, inactive + stale rejection, empty/mode-mismatch exceptions, write-once fields; missing <3-history and concurrent-skip cases.

review.summary: Implements CallNextTicket with correct ordering, fairness, queue/candidate locking and contract, plus comprehensive Pest tests and docs updates. Approve with nits: missing PHPDoc, stale architecture TODO, and two untested edges (short call history, concurrent skip).
